biggest_catch: Same-day pay (Instapay) costs you 5% of every payout ($5 flat in CA) — free weekly pay exists, but then you're waiting until Saturday.
catches: Instapay charges an expedited fee: 5% of the payout everywhere, $5 flat in California — on a $100 payout that's $5 gone.
Free option is Weekly pay only (checking: money in account Saturday after the pay period).
Instapay to a personal debit card lands ~1 hour after the shift ends; to checking it takes 3 business days.
Instapay is 1099-earnings only in the help article; W-2 shifts have different timing; not available for some shifts.
1099 gigs: you get 100% of earnings but owe your own taxes; W-2 shifts have taxes deducted.

steps: Sign up on Instawork, create your profile, and get approved for position categories.
Book a shift — the app shows the pay before you accept.
Clock in/out via the app's GPS time tracker during the shift.
Choose payment settings: Instapay (same-day, 5%/$5 fee) or Weekly (free).
Instapay to a personal debit card lands about 1 hour after the shift ends.
timing: Instapay to a personal debit card: ~1 hour after the shift ends (5% fee, $5 in CA). Weekly pay to checking is free, landing Saturday after the pay period.
who_pays: Instawork pays you for the shift — 1099 shifts pay you 100% of earnings (you handle your own taxes); W-2 shifts have taxes deducted.
who_qualifies: 18+; ID plus eligibility to work in the US; approved for the position categories you want to work; 1099 or W-2 depending on the shift.
work_available: Shifts are posted in the app per market, and you must be approved for the right position categories to see them. Availability depends on your metro.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the shift as booked. Same-day Instapay is available for eligible 1099 earnings only — W-2 shifts follow different timing.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: waiting between shifts; 1099 gigs leave taxes to you. Same-day Instapay costs 5% of each payout ($5 flat in California).
when_cash_arrives: Instapay to a personal debit card lands about an hour after the shift ends (5% fee, $5 in CA). The free option is weekly pay to checking, landing Saturday after the pay period.

repeatable.cadence: New shifts post regularly — finish a shift, use Instapay about an hour later, and claim the next shift.
